app_fee.value: The Graduate School application fee is $100 for all applicants.
app_fee.quote: The application fee for admission to the Graduate School is $100.

fee_waiver.value: Everyone must pay the fee except in narrow cases (re-applying within a year of declining an offer, US-citizen financial hardship, US veterans, certain US access programs). Some departments offer their own limited waivers; see the program record.
fee_waiver.quote: All applicants are required to pay the application fee, with limited exceptions (see below)

gre_general.value: The Graduate School leaves the GRE General Test to each program; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT total of 5 for doctoral applicants on the current 1-6 scale (tests taken after 21 Jan 2026); 90 on the old 0-120 scale for earlier tests.
toefl_min.quote: Exams taken prior to 1/21/2026: Overall score of 90 for doctoral applicants and 80 for master’s applicants. | Exams taken after 1/21/2026: Total score of 5 for doctoral applicants and 4.5 for master’s applicants.

ielts_min.value: IELTS overall 6.5, with no subscore recommended below 6.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: Overall score of 6.5, with no subsection recommended to be below 6.

english_waiver.value: No English test is needed if you hold a degree (including a bachelor's) from an institution whose primary language of instruction was English; you declare this in the application.
english_waiver.quote: There is no need to submit an English language proficiency test if: you hold a degree such as a high school diploma, bachelors, masters, or PhD from an institution where the primary instruction was in English.

notes: Graduate School deadlines vary by program and are listed in the Graduate Admissions portal. Teaching assistantships also require a minimum TOEFL/IELTS speaking score.
